"""Medium end-to-end: plan -> audit through the JSONL driver."""
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
rng = random.Random(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
K=16
x=[rng.randint(-500,500) for _ in range(K)]
ms=[]
for i in range(1,K):
    j=rng.randrange(i); d=x[j]-x[i]
    ms.append([i,j,d-rng.randint(0,3),d+rng.randint(0,3)])
while len(ms)<200:
    a=rng.randrange(K); b=rng.randrange(K)
    if a==b: continue
    d=x[b]-x[a]; ms.append([a,b,d-9,d+9])
prof={"groups":K,"jitter_ps":[rng.randint(0,5) for _ in range(K)],"measurements":ms}
N=64; T=7; S=23; Q=4
from math import gcd
P=(Q*S)//gcd(T,Q*S)
links=[]
for l in range(96):
    a=l%N; b=(l*7+3)%N
    if a==b: b=(b+1)%N
    links.append({"ends":[[a,l%32,rng.randrange(K)],[b,(l+5)%32,rng.randrange(K)]],
                  "delay_ns":[rng.randint(1,8*T),rng.randint(1,8*T)],
                  "defer_rounds":[rng.randint(0,8),rng.randint(0,8)]})
slices=[]
for q in range(Q):
    sel=[]; ports=set()
    cand=list(range(len(links))); rng.shuffle(cand)
    for l in cand:
        e=links[l]['ends']; p0=(e[0][0],e[0][1]); p1=(e[1][0],e[1][1])
        if p0 in ports or p1 in ports: continue
        ports.add(p0); ports.add(p1); sel.append(l)
        if len(sel)>=24: break
    slices.append(sel)
heat=[[rng.randrange(N),rng.randint(0,P-1),rng.randint(1,P),rng.randint(0,50)] for _ in range(200)]
heat=[h for h in heat if h[1]<h[2]]
anch=[[rng.randrange(N),rng.randint(0,P-1),rng.randint(1,P)] for _ in range(40)]
anch=[a for a in anch if a[1]<a[2]]
bl=[[rng.randrange(len(links)),rng.randint(0,P-1),rng.randint(1,P)] for _ in range(60)]
bl=[b for b in bl if b[1]<b[2]]
guards=[0,2,5,9]
fb={"n":N,"interval_ns":T,"slice_ns":S,"offset_ns":rng.randint(0,S-1),"drift_ppb":[rng.randint(0,20) for _ in range(N)],
    "heat":heat,"anchors":anch,"links":links,"slices":slices,"blackouts":bl,
    "guards_ns":guards,"reconfig_ns":rng.randint(0,3)}
print('P',P,'V',N*P,'occurrences',sum(len(slices[( (fb['offset_ns']+p*T)//S)%Q]) for p in range(P)))
reqs=[{"op":"plan","profile":prof,"fabric":fb}]
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(reqs[0])+"\n",capture_output=True,text=True)
assert p.returncode==0, p.stderr[:2000]
plan=json.loads(p.stdout.strip())
print('plan keys',sorted(plan.keys()))
print('peaks',plan['peaks_as'],'guard',plan['guard_ns'],'warm',plan['warmup_cycle'])
t0=time.time()
p2=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                  input=json.dumps({"op":"audit","profile":prof,"fabric":fb,"proposal":plan})+"\n",
                  capture_output=True,text=True)
print('audit',p2.stdout.strip(),'%.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), p2.stderr[:500])
# replay on the same fabric
R=40
eff=[[fb['drift_ppb'][i]]*P for i in range(N)]
for (nd,a,b,e) in heat:
    for pp in range(a,b): eff[nd][pp]+=e
rates=[[rng.randint(-eff[i][t%P],eff[i][t%P]) for i in range(N)] for t in range(R)]
import para
cal=para.build_calib(prof)
bias=[cal.upper[0][v] for v in range(K)]
sends=[]
ids=rng.sample(range(10**9),3000)
for pid in ids:
    c=rng.randrange(2*len(links))
    e=links[c>>1]['ends']; s,d=(e[0],e[1]) if c%2==0 else (e[1],e[0])
    lim=(prof['jitter_ps'][s[2]]+prof['jitter_ps'][d[2]])*10**6
    sends.append([pid,rng.randrange(R),c,rng.randint(-lim,lim)])
lost=[s[0] for s in sends if rng.random()<0.15]
reb=[]; seen=set()
for _ in range(400):
    t=rng.randint(0,R); n=rng.randrange(N)
    if (t,n) in seen: continue
    seen.add((t,n)); reb.append([t,n])
q=[rng.randint(0,R) for _ in range(6)]
trace={"rounds":R,"rates_ppb":rates,"bias_ps":bias,"sends":sends,"lost":lost,"reboots":reb,"queries":q}
t0=time.time()
p3=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                  input=json.dumps({"op":"replay","profile":prof,"fabric":fb,"guard_ns":guards[1],"trace":trace})+"\n",
                  capture_output=True,text=True)
r=json.loads(p3.stdout.strip())
print('replay %.1fs'%(time.time()-t0), {k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='states' and k!='send_status'})
print('states',len(r['states']),'cells',len(r['states'][0]['bounds_as']))
import collections
print(collections.Counter(r['send_status']))
PYEOF
